scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I trust that you are enjoying
life as a Super Novice? Ah,
good good...just as I expected.
Verily, the light of mediocrity is shining brightly within you...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
超級初心者的生活，你一定很享受吧？
啊，很好，很好...果然不出我所料。
平庸的光輝，正在你心中閃耀...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I encourage you to live
life as Mister Kimu-Shaun did...
Become a Jack of All Trades...
...and a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
希望你像金姆·肖恩先生那樣生活...
樣樣都會...
...卻樣樣不精。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Ah, you've brought the
items I've requested!
You've proven yourself
worthy of joining our
Super Novice Society.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
啊，我要的東西，你都帶來了！
你已經證明自己有資格加入超級初心者協會。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Then, as promised, I will
change your job into a
^3355FFSuper Novi--^000000Huh?
What's that behind you?
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
那麼，按約定，我就讓你轉職為^3355FF超級初——^000000咦？
你身後是什麼？

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou look behind you, but...
There's nothing's there.
Something fishy is going on here!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你回頭一看，卻...
什麼都沒有。
這事有點蹊蹺！^000000

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Bwaha! I got you!
So...how do you like my joke?
Oh well, let's forget that...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
Bwaha! 上當了吧！
怎麼樣，我這玩笑還不錯吧？
算了，不提這個了...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
As well as any possible
reason a grown man such as
myself would carry around
a pair of Panties.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
也別問我一個大男人，為什麼會隨身帶著一條內褲了。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
The important thing is...
you have joined the esteemed
ranks of the great Super Novices.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
重要的是...你已經光榮地加入偉大的超級初心者行列！

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Consider these Panties a gift...
This very garment is rumored
to be worn by Mister Kimu-Shaun,
our legendary club founder, in
his early days in striving for
exemplary mediocrity.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
這條內褲，就當作送你的禮物吧...
據說，我們的傳奇創始人金姆·肖恩先生，早年追求極致平庸時，穿的就是它。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Go out, and enjoy your new life
as a Super Novice! Venture
forth and help the common
man, while being one at at
the same time!
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
去吧，享受超級初心者的新生活！
去冒險，幫助普通人，同時也做一個普通人！

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Huh? Did you forget what I
wanted from you? Okay,
I will let you know once
again. Please remember
this time...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
咦？忘了我要你帶什麼？
好吧，我再說一次，這回可要記住...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I asked you to bring me
^FF000030 Sticky Mucus^000000 and
^FF000030 Resin^000000.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
我要你帶來^FF000030個粘稠液體^000000和^FF000030個樹脂^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
...Hmm?
Stop.
Let me look at you.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
...嗯？
等等，讓我看看你。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I see that the light
of mediocrity shines
brightly within you...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
我看見了，你心中正閃耀著平庸的光輝...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Why don't you join us,
young Novice? Join
us and learn the subtle
greatness of being
mediocre...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
年輕的初心者，何不加入我們？
和我們一起，領悟平庸之中不為人知的偉大...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Accept my offer...
Cast off your those
brown, dusty garments
and bloom into...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
接受我的提議吧...
脫下那身沾滿塵土的棕色衣服，蛻變成...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
...a ^CE6300Super Novice^000000.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
...一位^CE6300超級初心者^000000。

scripts.text: Accept his offer.
scripts.translation: 接受他的提議

scripts.text: Reject his offer.
scripts.translation: 拒絕他的提議

scripts.text: Listen more carefully.
scripts.translation: 再仔細聽聽

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmm...But do you truly
appreciate the value of
finding strength in
weakness? You must
prove to me that you
are a true underachiever.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
嗯...不過，你真的懂得從弱小中尋找力量的價值嗎？
你必須向我證明，你是真正的平庸之人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Live life as a Novice...
And return when you
have mastered the
Basic Skills...
Grow in mediocrity and
Become a Level 10 Novice...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
繼續以初心者的身份生活...
掌握基本技能之後，再回來...
在平庸中成長，成為10級的初心者...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmm...But do you truly
value the relaxed lifestyle
of the banal adventurer?
Prove to me that you do not
lust for power...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
嗯...你真的珍視平凡冒險者那悠閒的生活嗎？
證明給我看，你並不貪求力量...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Live life mundanely...
Become a Level 45 Novice...
It will be then that you can join us...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
平凡地生活...
成為一名45級的初心者...
到那時，你才能加入我們...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I can see in your eyes
the determination to
live life simply...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
我從你的眼中，看到了過簡單生活的決心...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Only the truly wise can
see that being ordinary
and banal is the best
way to live life.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
只有真正有智慧的人，才能明白平凡、平庸才是最好的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
However, we do not welcome
just anyone into our society.
You must first pass our
qualification test.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
不過，我們的協會可不是誰都能加入的。
你得先通過資格測試。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
For this test, you must
bring me some items which
are dropped from normal,
unexceptional monsters.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
測試的內容，就是帶來一些普通魔物掉落的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmmmm...
^FF000030 Sticky Mucus^000000
and ^FF000030 Resin
^000000will be suitable to test your
ability to fight meager enemies.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
嗯...
^FF000030個粘稠液體^000000和^FF000030個樹脂^000000，就足以考驗你對付弱小敵人的能力了。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Also, the number 30
is significant. It's not
anything special...just
an ordinary number.
Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
還有，30這個數字也很有意義。
它沒什麼特別的...只是個普通數字。
Hahahahaha~

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Good luck, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
祝你好運，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Well, well...I suppose the
value of the simple life
is difficult for you to
to grasp. It's...okay...
Your life is your own.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
唉...看來你還很難領會簡單生活的價值。
沒...沒關係...
你的人生，由你做主。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
But, if you ever see the
light of banality, you
are welcome to visit me
anytime...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
不過，哪天你若看見了平庸的光輝，隨時歡迎來找我...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
As our Novice club
grows more popular and
we gain more followers,
we may consider using
a more difficult test...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
等初心者協會越來越受歡迎，追隨者越來越多，我們也許會考慮採用更難的測試...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Our Novice Society was founded
by the legendary Mister
Kimu-Shaun...perhaps the
greatest man in our generation.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
我們的初心者協會，由傳奇人物金姆·肖恩先生創立...
他或許是我們這一代最偉大的人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
He realized that there
was much suffering in the
world, especially among
the common people of
Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
他發現，世間充滿苦難，尤其是米德加爾特的普通百姓...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
He learned many skills from
all the different people he
met...but since he didn't
stay in one place for long,
he became a jack of all
trades...and a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
他向旅途中遇到的各種人學習，掌握了許多技能...
可他從不在一處久留，最後成了樣樣都會...卻樣樣不精的人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
In sharing the pain of
the common man, he became
became one himself...
the greatest ordinary
man ever.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
他與普通人分擔痛苦，自己也成了其中一員...
成了有史以來最偉大的普通人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
The members of our society
try to live as Mister
Kimu-Shaun did, according to
the principles he laid before us...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
我們協會的成員，都努力遵循金姆·肖恩先生留下的原則，像他那樣生活...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
How do you like living
life simply as a Super
Novice? I'm sure that
you're enjoying it~
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
身為超級初心者，過著簡單的生活，感覺如何？
我相信，你一定很享受~

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Please grow as a Super
Novice by helping the
common man while being
one at the same time...
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
身為超級初心者，幫助普通人的同時，也保持自己的平凡，以此不斷成長...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I encourage you to
grow in your Super
Noviceness, and lead
an example in living
an exceptionally
mundane life.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
希望你不斷提升超級初心者的境界，以身作則，過上極其平凡的生活。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hello, I am Tzerero,
the unofficial executive
director of the Great
Novice Society.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
你好，我是澤雷羅，偉大初心者協會的非正式執行總監。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmmm...you seem to be well
above the average person.
Yes, you're definitely more
'extraordinary' than you are
'ordinary...'
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
嗯...你似乎遠勝於普通人。
沒錯，比起“平凡”，你顯然更稱得上“非凡”...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
*Sigh* I suppose you
could never understand
our way of life, the
subtle greatness in
being ordinary. But
that's alright.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
*嘆氣*看來，你很難理解我們的生活方式，理解平凡之中那不為人知的偉大。
不過，沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Well...there are thousands
of different people in this
world, so I just try to accept
all of our differences.
I hope you will too.
scripts.translation:
[澤雷羅]
嗯...世間有形形色色的人，我也試著接受彼此的差異。
希望你也能如此。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
You! Stronger than before.
I knew you could pass the test~
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
你呀！比以前更強了。
我就知道你能通過測試~

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Hm? Hey, you're a member
of our great Novice Society,
aren't you? Isn't this the
best club ever?!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
嗯？嘿，你是我們偉大初心者協會的成員吧？
這難道不是世上最棒的協會嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Essaray]
Living life mundanely,
according to the principles
of Mister Kimu-Shaun...
It's great to be ordinary!
scripts.translation:
[艾薩雷]
遵循金姆·肖恩先生的原則，平凡地生活...
做個普通人真好！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Let's try to lead our lives
as normally as we can!
For your reference, I am
the number one member,
under Mister Tzerero of
course!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
讓我們儘量過平凡的生活吧！
順便一提，我可是協會的頭號成員！
當然，澤雷羅先生除外！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Hah~ you don't know anything
about being a normal person yet!
Why don't you join our Novice
Society? This club is the best in the world~
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
哈~你還不懂做普通人的滋味呢！
何不加入我們的初心者協會？
這可是世上最棒的協會~

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Yup, Super Novices
are the best characters!
Hahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
沒錯，超級初心者是最棒的角色！
Hahahahahahahaha!

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Bah~! You're better than
average...Hell, you may
even be 'special.'
What a shame! Well...
I hope you still live
your life positively.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
嘁~！你比普通人強...天哪，甚至稱得上“特別”。
真遺憾！不過...還是希望你積極地生活。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello, Mister Super Novice~
You must have been really
dissapointed that the other
Kafra Employees wouldn't let
you rent a cart from them.
But don't you worry now...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您好，超級初心者先生~
其他卡普拉職員不肯租手推車給您，您一定很失望吧。
不過，現在不用擔心了...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello, Super Novice, Ma'am.
You must have been really
dissapointed that the other
Kafra Employees wouldn't let
you rent a cart from them.
But don't you worry now...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您好，超級初心者女士。
其他卡普拉職員不肯租手推車給您，您一定很失望吧。
不過，現在不用擔心了...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm here to support you guys
by providing carts...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
我就是來為你們提供手推車，支援你們的...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^3355FF*whispers*^000000
^555555I am not supposed to do this
because it's against our
company policy. But I felt
really sorry for Super Novices
...so here I am.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
^3355FF*小聲說*^000000
^555555其實，我不該這麼做，因為這違反了公司規定。
可我實在不忍心看超級初心者這麼為難...所以就來了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Anyway, would you like to rent a cart? The service fee is 1,900 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
那麼，您想租用手推車嗎？
服務費是1,900 Zeny。

scripts.text: Rent a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推車

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, here's the thing...
Have you learned the 'Push Cart'
skill? I can just rent you a
cart, but if you haven't
learned to push it, you'll
just be wasting your zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
哦，還有件事...
您學會“手推車使用”技能了嗎？
我可以租手推車給您，但如果您不會使用，就只是白白浪費Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
So make sure that you have
the 'Push Cart' skill already.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
所以，請先確認自己已經學會“手推車使用”技能。

scripts.text: Rent a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推車

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, you've already equipped a cart.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
哦，您已經有手推車了。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you for using my service.
Although what I am doing might
not be legitimate to other
Kafra Employees, I strongly
believe I am doing what's right for the customers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
感謝您使用我的服務。
雖然其他卡普拉職員可能認為這不合規，但我堅信，我是在為顧客做正確的事。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am sorry, but you do not have enough zeny with you. The service fee is 1,900 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。
服務費是1,900 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please come again.
Thank you for using my services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
歡迎再次光臨。
感謝您使用我的服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please come again.
Thank you for using my services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
歡迎再次光臨。
感謝您使用我的服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Good da--Oops...!
I don't think I can provide you
with the services you want...
Please go talk to another
Kafra employee. I apologize
for such inconvenience...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您好——哎呀...！
恐怕我無法提供您需要的服務...
請找其他卡普拉職員。
給您帶來不便，實在抱歉...
